theory.target: Audit direction of unit orthogonality and the immaculate locus on fixed products of projective spaces by exact Cech cochain certificates; no general CCC or wrapped-Floer theorem.
definitions: Immaculate means H^q(X,L)=0 for every q including zero.
For invertible L, RHom(O,L)=RΓ(L) and RHom(L,O)=RΓ(L dual).
Cech degree q has nonempty subsets S of size q+1 containing the negative exponent support N; differential is signed inclusion.
Degrees range from -6 through 6 on P2xP2, P1xP2 and (P1)^3.
assumptions: Standard affine cover computes coherent cohomology; product cover is the tensor total complex over a field.
RHom(O,L)=RΓ(L); RHom(L,O)=RΓ(L dual) for invertible L.
Any mirror-orthogonality conclusion is conditional on a specified fully faithful equivalence and its variance.
approaches_considered: Closed projective-space cohomology windows and binomial product dimensions.
Exact Cech incidence matrices, tensor total complexes and integer contractions.
Direction-free orthogonality shortcut and overgeneralized collinear-ray necessity, rejected in the fixed example.
falsification_targets: Opposite Hom directions with different vanishing.
Boundary errors at degree -n, -n-1 and zero.
Wrong tensor signs, contracting homotopies or ray collinearity.

claims.statement: The proposed equivalence of RHom(O,L) and RHom(L,O) vanishing is false. On P2xP2, L=O(-1,0) gives zero in the first direction and dimension three in degree zero in the second.
claims.falsification_condition: An incorrect dualization, Cech differential or monomial count for the witness.

claims.statement: All 2,535 degree tuples and both Hom directions agree between implementations; 940 tuples have asymmetric vanishing. The P2xP2 fan has no collinear pair among its six rays.
claims.falsification_condition: A missing degree tuple, wrong Betti entry or rank-deficient ray pair.

claims.statement: All 28 single-factor and 160 product-support cochain complexes have the recorded Betti profiles. All 22 mixed-support homotopies satisfy dh+hd=I over the integers.
claims.falsification_condition: Any incorrect incidence sign, rank or integer homotopy identity.

claims.statement: The ordinary product-cohomology argument gives immaculacy precisely when some degree lies in its factor window [-ni,-1]; mirror transfer additionally requires a specified fully faithful functor and correct variance. Universal proof remains unverified by an independent author or kernel.
claims.falsification_condition: Failure of the affine-cover model, tensor cohomology, contraction or functor-variance identification.

claims.statement: Stacks 01XS gives projective-space cohomology. Borisov-Duncan v2 Theorem 1.1 gives a forbidden-cone criterion under its stated characteristic-zero hypotheses, not a mirror theorem; AIM page unavailable.
claims.falsification_condition: Wrong version, locator, hypotheses or conflation of the criterion with a mirror-equivalence claim.
